lanes.label: U.S. presidential office-business-capital crossings, 1979 to present
lanes.public_interest_question: How do identifier-resolved public records document office, committee, beneficial-interest, business, payment, issuer, and policy crossings for every U.S. president serving during the federal financial-disclosure era under one frozen predicate battery?
lanes.selection_unit: one distinct cohort member and each identifier-resolved filing, transaction, disposition, beneficial-interest record, or time-bounded office and business role returned under the common battery
lanes.selection_universe: every distinct person whose service as President of the United States intersects 1979-01-01 through the dated cohort capture, enumerated before entity or transaction queries, with the same five role-neutral predicates applied to every member
inclusion_rules: include every distinct president whose service intersects the frozen 1979-to-capture window before resolving any business or transaction identifier
include every record meeting one of the five frozen predicates under the same identifier, evidence, temporal, and beneficial-interest tests for all cohort members
exclusion_rules: no person enters or leaves because of party, wealth, business structure, allegation volume, expected scandal value, or expected null result
no target-specific asset, product, property type, policy topic, surname substring, or ad hoc dollar threshold may define the common predicate battery

comparison.comparator_class: all eight distinct U.S. presidents whose service intersects the dated 1979-to-present federal financial-disclosure-era window
comparison.symmetry_rule: Enumerate the office-defined cohort before entity queries, then apply the frozen five-predicate battery to every member and preserve nulls, failures, and coverage differences regardless of party or expected result.

review.sunset_condition: Discovery and intake continue with explicit pending-review and source-coverage labels. Do not publish a cleared crossing if the office-defined cohort, frozen predicate battery, historical-coverage accounting, independent adversarial review, source-addressable transaction and beneficial-interest records, temporal test, or entity resolution is absent.

lanes.label: K0 epistemic-admissibility and ceiling-conversion events
lanes.public_interest_question: When a qualified knower contradicts a gateholder, which documented classifications and gate actions remove the institution’s capacity to learn, and which independent controls preserve standing, evidence, and pre-action stopping power?
lanes.selection_unit: one bounded gate action preceded by a documented contradiction from a person or body with a stated qualification basis
lanes.selection_universe: all publicly recoverable events across declared gate classes and jurisdictions under the same event predicate, including nulls, rejected cases, designed ceilings, strategic bypasses, and effective counterpower controls
inclusion_rules: a bounded domain, gate, authority basis, governing claim, and qualified contradiction are source-addressable
the record supports a traceable gate action or attempted gate action plus a stated consequence or explicit null
alternative explanations, counterevidence, attribution scope, and source limitations are preserved
exclusion_rules: fame, dislike, party, ideology, nationality, wealth, or anticipated news value as the selection basis
ordinary disagreement, poor outcomes, or later vindication without a documented reclassification or gate conversion
private psychological diagnosis or person-level attribution without a traceable act of authority
common causal shape treated as coordination or common purpose

comparison.comparator_class: all events and negative controls returned by the same gate-action and contradiction predicate across declared strata
comparison.symmetry_rule: Apply identical event fields, CCD completion rules, source thresholds, counterevidence requirements, null preservation, and attribution limits regardless of actor identity or institutional alignment.

review.sunset_condition: Keep the lane publication-blocked if the role-neutral universe, source-addressable receipts, null denominator, or independent adversarial review cannot be maintained.
